AboutPage.title: We were born to bring this hobby we love closer to you.
AboutPage.quote: If an Argentine pilot can fly just as well as a world champion, we did our job right.

OurStory.imageAlt: ChoppersRC pilots flying an RC helicopter in an open field
OurStory.p1: It all started with a problem every Argentine pilot knows: the best products exist, but they're on the other side of the world.
OurStory.p2: ChoppersRC came from the initiative of Luis, its owner and lifelong pilot, tired of watching the local community fall short every time. Kits that never arrived, parts impossible to find, endless imports, and the constant feeling of building the hobby with whatever was available, not what you actually wanted to fly.
OurStory.p3: That's how the idea was born: bring top-quality imported products that aren't available here into the country, and put them within everyone's reach in one place. The brands champions choose, motors that truly perform, batteries you can trust when the heli is thirty meters up. No second choices.
OurStory.p4: But ChoppersRC is, above all, much more than a store. It's the meeting point for a community that grows flight by flight. Behind every order is someone who answers your questions before you buy. Yes, we sell products, but what we build is trust.
OurStory.p5: Because the goal was never to sell for the sake of selling. The goal is for you to enjoy the hobby worry-free, to find everything in one safe place, to have it arrive when it should, and for the only thing on your mind to be when you'll take off again.

AboutValues.v1Description: We only carry the brands and products we'd fly ourselves. Imported, original and tested — no imitations, no second choices.

FaqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
FaqPage.description: The most common questions about shipping, payments, warranties and returns. If you can't find what you're looking for, write to us.

FaqItems.q1: How long does my order take to arrive?
FaqItems.a1: Shipments to the AMBA area usually arrive within 24 to 48 business hours. To the rest of the country, between 3 and 7 business days depending on the location and courier. We send you the tracking code as soon as we dispatch the order.
FaqItems.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
FaqItems.a2: Bank transfer and cash on pickup or delivery. If you choose transfer, we show you the CBU and alias as soon as you confirm the purchase.
FaqItems.q3: Can I pick up my order at the store?
FaqItems.a3: Yes. At checkout you can choose free in-store pickup. We'll notify you by email and WhatsApp as soon as it's ready.
FaqItems.q4: Do the products have a warranty?
FaqItems.a4: All products carry an official warranty from the manufacturer or importer, between 3 and 12 months depending on the item. The details for each warranty are on the product page.
FaqItems.q5: How do I request a return or exchange?
FaqItems.a5: You have 10 days from receiving your order to request an exchange or return, as long as the product is unused and in its original packaging. Write to us on WhatsApp or from your account under My Orders.
FaqItems.q6: Are the products original and imported?
FaqItems.a6: Yes, we only work with official brands and direct imports. We don't sell replicas or clones — everything we list is something we'd fly ourselves.
FaqItems.a7: Yes, we ship all over Argentina through major couriers and logistics companies. Cost and estimated time are calculated at checkout based on your postal code.
FaqItems.q8: What do I do if my product arrives with a problem?
FaqItems.a8: Write to us as soon as you notice it, with photos or video if possible. We cover replacement or repair as applicable under the warranty, at no cost to you.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.description: What data we collect, what we use it for, and what cookies the site uses.
PrivacyPage.s1P1: ChoppersRC is the controller of the personal data collected through choppersrc.com. For any questions about this policy, you can reach us through the channels listed in the Contact section.
PrivacyPage.s2P1: Depending on how you use the site, we may collect: first and last name, email, phone number, shipping address, order history, and browsing data (pages visited, device, IP address) through our own and third-party cookies.
PrivacyPage.s2P2: We don't request or store card details or other payment information — that's processed directly by each payment gateway when applicable.
PrivacyPage.s3Title: 3. What we use your data for
PrivacyPage.s3P1: We use your data to process and deliver your orders, answer questions, manage your account, comply with legal/tax obligations, and — only if you accepted analytics cookies — understand how the site is used in order to improve it.
PrivacyPage.s4Title: 4. Who we share your data with
PrivacyPage.s4P1: We share data with third parties only when necessary to provide the service: couriers and logistics companies (to deliver your order) and Google Analytics (for usage statistics, only if you accepted analytics cookies).
PrivacyPage.s4P2: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.
PrivacyPage.s5P1: A cookie is a small file the site stores in your browser. We use two types: necessary cookies, which you can't disable because the site doesn't work without them (keeping you logged in, remembering your cart), and analytics cookies, which only activate if you accept them from the cookie notice, and which you can decline without affecting your purchase.
PrivacyPage.s5P2: You can change your choice at any time by deleting the site's cookies from your browser settings — the notice will appear again on your next visit.
s5Row3: Distinguishes unique visitors for site usage statistics.
PrivacyPage.s6P1: Under Ley 25.326, you have the right to access, rectify, update and request deletion of your personal data. You can exercise these rights by writing to us through the Contact channels, or directly with the Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP) if you feel your request wasn't properly addressed.
PrivacyPage.s7P1: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data (encrypted connection, restricted access to account and order information). No system is 100% foolproof, but we work to minimize the risks.
PrivacyPage.s8P1: By using Google Analytics, some browsing data is processed on servers outside Argentina (Google LLC, United States), under Google's clauses and safeguards for data processing.
PrivacyPage.s9P1: We may update this Privacy Policy at any time. The version in effect is always the one published on this page, along with its last-updated date.
PrivacyPage.s10P1: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, write to us through the channels listed in the Contact section.

TermsPage.title: Terms and conditions
TermsPage.description: The conditions governing use of the site and your purchases at ChoppersRC.
TermsPage.s1P1: By accessing or purchasing on choppersrc.com you accept these Terms and Conditions in full. If you disagree with any part of them, please do not use the site.
TermsPage.s2P1: ChoppersRC sells radio-controlled helicopters, parts and model-aircraft accessories, to both end consumers and distributors, in and outside Argentina.
TermsPage.s3P1: To make a purchase you can register with your email or continue as a guest. You're responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity carried out from your account.
TermsPage.s3P2: We reserve the right to suspend or cancel accounts with false information, fraudulent use, or breach of these terms.
TermsPage.s4P1: Listed prices are expressed in Argentine pesos (ARS) and include applicable taxes, unless stated otherwise. We reserve the right to change prices and stock without prior notice.
TermsPage.s4P2: We do our best to make photos and descriptions match the actual product; small differences in color or packaging do not constitute a defect.
TermsPage.s5P1: The purchase is confirmed once payment is credited via bank transfer or cash (pickup/delivery). The order is held for 48 hours while the transfer is credited.
TermsPage.s6P1: We ship nationwide through third-party couriers and logistics companies. The estimated timeframe is shown at checkout and may vary for reasons beyond ChoppersRC's control (strikes, weather, delivery area).
TermsPage.s7P1: You have 10 calendar days from receipt to request an exchange or return, under the right of withdrawal in Ley 24.240, provided the product is unused and in its original packaging.
TermsPage.s7P2: Each product carries the warranty stated on its page, covering manufacturing defects. The warranty doesn't cover misuse, impacts, water damage, or normal wear of parts (blades, gears, etc.).
TermsPage.s8P1: All site content (text, images, logo, design) is owned by ChoppersRC or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property law. Reproduction without prior authorization is prohibited.
TermsPage.s9P1: The site may not be used for fraudulent purposes, to attempt to breach its security, or to post offensive or illegal content on any available contact channel (form, WhatsApp, blog comments).
TermsPage.s10P1: ChoppersRC is not liable for indirect damages arising from the use of radio-control products, which by their nature require proper skill and supervision. Flying is the user's sole responsibility.
TermsPage.s11P1: We may update these Terms and Conditions at any time. The version in effect is always the one published on this page, along with its last-updated date.
TermsPage.s12P1: These terms are governed by the laws of Argentina. In case of any dispute, the parties submit to the competent ordinary courts, without prejudice to consumers' right to choose the court of their domicile.
TermsPage.s13P1: For questions about these terms, you can write to us through the channels listed in the Contact section.
